targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at) AS time, 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS events FROM iot.customer_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'products', count(*) FROM iot.product_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM iot.purchase_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM iot.product_on_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'invoices', count(*) FROM iot.invoice_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM iot.inventory_changes WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM iot.truck_fleet_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at), 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM iot.truck_position_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'customers' AS domain, count(*) AS events_last_5min FROM iot.customer_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'products', count(*) FROM iot.product_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_orders', count(*) FROM iot.purchase_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'product_on_orders', count(*) FROM iot.product_on_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'invoices', count(*) FROM iot.invoice_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM iot.inventory_changes WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_fleet', count(*) FROM iot.truck_fleet_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM iot.truck_position_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY events_last_5min DESC
SELECT dag_id, state, count(*) AS runs FROM public.dag_run WHERE start_date > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY dag_id, state ORDER BY dag_id, state
SELECT topic, partition, last_offset, updated_at, extract(epoch from (now()-updated_at)) AS staleness_seconds FROM control.kafka_offsets ORDER BY staleness_seconds DESC
